Candidate changes the near knee to the raised phase and places the second foot lower on the opposite side of the crank; fork meets front axle and the crank remains at the frame junction. The pedal cycle is legible in this still.

In the source the front wheel extends beyond the lower border as the camera composition moves closer/lower; the candidate instead keeps the complete front tire above a horizontal ground line with a generous bottom margin.

Source again crops the front tire at the lower border and shifts the wheel/leg relationship within the frame. Candidate keeps the whole front wheel visible at essentially its earlier scale and bottom clearance. Two shoes remain identifiable rather than proliferating into disconnected extras.

main_gap: The lower two candidate keys freeze the front wheel's complete, grounded framing while the source cuts off its bottom. This weakens the required changing camera/crop despite a plausible pedaling reconstruction.

protected_strengths: Recognizable sparse-spoked bicycle and angular frame/fork vocabulary.
